Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: Teleport home while Return is on cooldown, sync shared hotbars between PvE and PvP, and withdraw saddlebag stacks while leaving one for easy duplicate entrusting. Each feature is independently enabled.
Punchline: Paid Return fallback, shared hotbar sync and saddlebag conveniences.
Changelog: 0.2.1.2: Add Saddlebag Withdraw All but One, disabled by default under Items and storage. Right-click a saddlebag stack of two or more to withdraw its quantity minus one, retaining a copy for Pandora's Entrust Duplicates matching. Covers regular and premium saddlebag tabs, preserves HQ/NQ, and checks the source and native quantity dialog before one submission. Keeps Return via Teleport and Shared Hotbar Sync. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.
